Method of Attack: Extract plaintext credentials from DVR devices by accessing the control panel with a cookie header 'Cookie: uid=admin', which causes the device to respond with admin credentials in cleartext
Exploitation of CVE-2018-9995 vulnerability allowing attackers to gain full access to DVR settings and live video feeds
Impacted Systems: Rebranded versions of TBK DVR4104 and DVR4216 series
DVR brands including Novo, CeNova, QSee, Pulnix, XVR 5 in 1, Securus, Night OWL, DVR Login, HVR Login, MDVR Login
Attack Vector: HTTP request to DVR control panel endpoints (/device.rsp?opt=user&cmd=list) with a crafted cookie header
Use of Shodan queries to identify vulnerable devices online
Indicators of Compromise: HTTP requests to /device.rsp or /login.rsp URL paths
User-agent string in PoC code containing misspelled terms 'Morzilla' and 'Pinux x86_128'
Date of Discovery: Tool published on Monday before article (date not specified)
Repository URL: GitHub repository containing the PoC code (exact URL not specified)
